title: Heart Rate Optimal
summary: A heart-rate alert that thinks it is a ballad. 78 and 78. The chorus would like to go to ninety; the watch does not approve.
visualArc: Watch face 78/78 → still woman closes a ring → ELEVATED chime at the same tempo → cracker, latte, robot → OPTIMAL.

segments.onScreen: Macro watch face. HR 78. Second ring also 78. Café neon in the glass.
segments.lyrics: Heart rate: seventy-eight. / Existential dread: also seventy-eight. / This is optimal.
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Macro of a sleek wellness smartwatch face reading HR 78 and a second ring also at 78, café neon reflecting in the glass, nocturnal, cinematic, Grok Imagine style

segments.label: Elevated (same tempo)
segments.onScreen: Watch flashes ELEVATED. The room does not speed up. Justine does not stand.
segments.lyrics: Heart rate optimal / Dread optimal / Same number / Different app
segments.musicCue: Attempted swell cut by three-note chime
segments.grokImaginePrompt: Close two-shot: watch face flashing ELEVATED in soft mint while a deadpan woman in a retro-tech café does not speed up, ping-pong paddle on the table, photoreal, Grok Imagine style
